summary: This lecture page introduces fundamental graph theory concepts essential for Deep Graph Learning, categorizing graphs by their structural properties such as directionality, weighting, and connectivity. It defines specific graph classes including simple, complete, hyper, heterogeneous, and annotated graphs, providing formal definitions and visual examples for each. The content concludes by detailing how graphs are mathematically represented using adjacency, feature, and edge matrices to facilitate computational processing.
